HONEST, SEPARATE, CONFIRMED FIRST

Simple pricing,
nothing hidden.

Our service charge is always shown separately from any government, portal, bank or insurer fee. You hear the amount before we start, and the receipt lists what was collected.

Printing and photocopy

Rates for the online print order, per page. Black & white pricing depends on the total pages in the order. Walk-in single pages start higher (see Common charges).

TypeRate per page
Black & white, 1 – 10 pages₹5
Black & white, 11 – 50 pages₹3
Black & white, 51+ pages₹2
Colour, any quantity₹10

Rates can change with the file, size and quantity, so ask us for the exact price before you print. Ask for a printing price

Services quoted before work starts

ServiceHow it is priced
PAN card, Aadhaar updates, certificates, voter IDOur assistance charge is confirmed on WhatsApp or at the desk before work starts. Government and portal fees, if any, are shown separately.
AEPS, money transfer, bill and fee paymentsA small service charge applies and is told to you before the transaction.
Insurance, banking and student formsOur assistance charge is confirmed per form. Premiums and bank charges go to the insurer or bank.
Laptop, printer and PC repair, hardwareQuoted after checking the device. Parts are priced on the day, so we send the latest price on WhatsApp.

What is never included

  • Government, portal, court, bank, insurer or other third-party fees. These go to them, not to us.
  • Delivery charges for print orders, unless stated.
  • Fees for correcting or re-filing an application that was wrong because of incomplete details.

Offers

Promo codes and welcome coupons reduce our service charge only, never government fees. See current offers.

Payment

You can pay at the desk in cash or UPI, or on your request's payment page: UPI QR is free (we confirm it manually, so it takes a little time), and instant card, net-banking or UPI payment adds a small payment-processing fee that is shown before you pay.

Cancellations and refunds

See the refund & cancellation policy.
